messages.subject: maximum size of the database
parts: I make use of shiny apps in my job. I would know if shinyapps.io have capacity for two big database (one database contains 17 millions of observations and 40 variables and other database contains 27 millions of observations and 40 variables) ? And if yes, I would know if occurs delay to run due to size of database?

messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: maximum size of the database
parts:
I presume you are asking about loading the data from these databases that you are hosting, as shinyapps.io doesn't provide a database itself. Alternatively, you might mean to store them as files that are uploaded with your application to shinyapps.io, in which case there is a limit of 1 GB for free and starter plans, and up to 5 GB for the higher tiers.

With respect to capacity, the answer depends completely upon how much of the data you are loading into memory at any given time, and how efficiently it is being stored in memory. Basic plans and higher have access to instance types that provide up to 8GB of memory.

With respect to delays, there are latency and throughput "costs" to transferring data across the Internet that would contribute to a delay.

Hope that helps.
